continuity_scope: FAIRY TAIL, Kodansha USA English manga Volume 1: print edition released 28 August 2012 (ISBN 9781612622767) and ebook edition released 16 July 2013 (EISBN 9781612624600), 208 pages. This is a narrow official English Volume 1 metadata pass, not a transcription or full panel-by-panel reading.

Kodansha USA official Volume 1/series product page
Kodansha USA archived Volume 1 product page

coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic character directly named in the selected Kodansha USA English Volume 1 synopsis: Lucy and Natsu. The unnamed talking cat, pirates, magician, wizards, Fairy Tail guild, magic, places, objects, and premise themes remain terms or omissions rather than invented character nodes.
omissions: The publisher synopsis does not name the talking cat, pirate leader, devious magician, guild members, or other Volume 1 characters, so they are excluded rather than identified from uninspected panels or franchise knowledge.
Later volumes, sequel manga including 100 Years Quest, companion/guide books, spinoffs, Japanese wording, anime, films, games, and adaptations are separate witnesses.
Guild membership, precise magic types, character powers, family/found-family development, locations, opponents, combat outcomes, and longer-arc spoilers are not asserted from this selected witness.
Fanservice, sexualization, nudity, exact violence, and content details are not characterized from an uninspected Volume 1; the official listing's 13+ rating is retained only as age metadata.
uncertainties: The official English page provides a synopsis and edition metadata but no browser-readable chapter or panel locators, so this is metadata-only.

The English synopsis calls Lucy a wizard and names Natsu as the person she meets; its statement that Natsu has a talking-cat best friend does not name that cat, so no third character or relationship is inferred.
The official series page bears a Made into Anime tag, but no anime characterization, continuity, or game claim is used.

Fairy Tail is called a club for powerful wizards in the English synopsis. This opening framing does not establish a later found-family interpretation, membership roster, rules, or institutional structure.
evidence_basis: Kodansha first-party English Volume 1 metadata only, with the Japanese Kodansha Volume 1 listing consulted solely to mark the original-language witness as separate. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, adaptation recap, uninspected manga panel, or long quotation is used.
